tagline: Urban Tech Oasis & Garden City Elegance

timings.early_check_in_policy: Early check-in from 9:00 AM is subject to availability upon arrival. Guaranteed early check-in before 9:00 AM can be secured for an early arrival fee of INR 1,500.
timings.late_check_out_policy: Late check-out up to 3:00 PM is available upon request for INR 1,500, subject to occupancy. Departures past 3:00 PM are billed at the full nightly room rate.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Sophisticated urban sanctuary featuring floor-to-ceiling soundproof windows, high-speed Wi-Fi, ergonomic work desk, and an Italian marble bathroom with rainfall shower.
amenities: Nespresso Coffee Machine & Organic Tea Selection
Italian Marble Bathroom with Rainfall Shower

rooms.name: Executive King Suite
rooms.bed_type: 1 King Bed + 1 Premium Pull-Out Sofa Bed
rooms.description: Expansive executive suite featuring a separate living parlor, walk-in dressing wardrobe, deep soaking bathtub, and exclusive access to the 14th Floor Executive Club Lounge.
amenities: Executive Club Lounge Access (Complimentary High Tea & Evening Cocktails)

rooms.name: Presidential Family Suite
rooms.bed_type: 2 King Bedrooms (2 King Beds or 1 King + 2 Twin Beds)
rooms.description: The pinnacle of luxury for families and small groups, boasting two master bedrooms, two en-suite marble bathrooms, a dining salon for 6, and dedicated 24/7 personal butler service.
amenities: Two Private Master Bedrooms with En-suite Marble Bathrooms
Spacious Dining & Living Salon with Dining Table for 6
Complimentary International Breakfast Buffet for up to 4 guests
Complimentary Baby Cot & Child Amenities upon request

dining.name: The Glasshouse Bistro
dining.cuisine: Contemporary Continental, Pan-Asian & Authentic South Indian Fine Dining
dining.breakfast_inclusion: A lavish international breakfast buffet is included complimentary with Executive King Suite and Presidential Family Suite bookings. For Deluxe Room guests on room-only plans, the breakfast buffet is available for INR 850 + taxes per guest.
dining.highlights: Live egg & dosa stations, artisanal sourdough bakery, fresh cold-pressed fruit juices, and barista-crafted specialty coffees.

dining.name: Skyline Rooftop Bar & Lounge
dining.cuisine: Artisan Cocktails, Tapas & Wood-fired Gourmet Pizzas
dining.highlights: Stunning open-air terrace with panoramic 15th-floor views of Bengaluru city, signature craft cocktails, and sunset lounge music.

dining.name: 24/7 In-Room Dining
dining.cuisine: Comprehensive round-the-clock comfort dining menu featuring Indian classics, pastas, light bowls, and late-night snacks.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation is permitted up to 24 hours prior to check-in (by 3:00 PM on the day preceding arrival). Cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows incur a one-night fee.
policies.pets: Well-behaved pets (up to 10 kg) are permitted exclusively in designated Deluxe Garden Patio rooms with prior notice. A deep cleaning fee of INR 2,000 applies.
policies.smoking: Oleria Bengaluru is a 100% smoke-free hotel. Smoking inside guest rooms incurs an INR 5,000 deep-cleaning fee. An outdoor smoking pavilion is in the courtyard.
policies.children: Children aged 5 and under stay complimentary sharing existing bedding. Baby cots are complimentary upon request. Extra beds are INR 1,200/night.
policies.id_requirements: All guests must present a valid government-approved photo ID (Passport, Aadhaar Card, Driving License, or Voter ID) at check-in. PAN cards are not accepted.

faqs.question: What time is check-in?
faqs.answer: Check-in at Oleria Bengaluru is from 3:00 PM onwards. Early check-in from 9:00 AM is subject to room availability upon arrival, or can be guaranteed in advance for INR 1,500.

faqs.question: What time is check-out?
faqs.answer: Check-out is at 11:00 AM. Late check-out up to 3:00 PM can be arranged for INR 1,500 subject to occupancy.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, our 15th-floor heated rooftop infinity pool offers sweeping skyline views of Bengaluru and is open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM complimentary for in-house guests.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included?
faqs.answer: An international breakfast buffet at The Glasshouse Bistro is included complimentary with Executive King Suite and Presidential Family Suite bookings. For Deluxe Room guests, it is INR 850 + taxes.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours prior to check-in (3:00 PM on the day before arrival). Cancellations within 24 hours are billed for one night.

faqs.question: Which room is suitable for three guests?
faqs.answer: Our Executive King Suite is ideal for three guests (featuring 1 King Bed plus a premium pull-out sofa bed in a spacious 58 sqm suite). Alternatively, our Presidential Family Suite easily accommodates up to four guests.

faqs.question: Do you offer airport transfers?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide private chauffeur-driven luxury transfers to Kempegowda International Airport (BLR) for a flat rate of INR 1,800. Presidential Suite guests receive one complimentary one-way transfer.
